pair.searchQuery: Seed investors focused on EV tech, AI/ML for predictive maintenance, ideally w/ fleet management experience. Looking for more than just capital – need industry expertise to scale AetherDrive.

userContactFile.positioning: As Founder & CEO of AetherDrive, I’m leading the charge in revolutionizing fleet management for the electric vehicle era. We leverage cutting-edge AI and machine learning to predict component failures *before* they impact operations, minimizing downtime and maximizing ROI for fleet owners. My background as a VP of Engineering at Stellantis provided me with invaluable insights into the complexities of automotive engineering and the urgent need for proactive maintenance solutions. I’ve spent the last 20+ years scaling engineering teams, driving innovation in battery technology, and optimizing manufacturing processes. At AetherDrive, I’m focused on building a world-class team, securing strategic partnerships, and scaling our platform to become the industry standard for EV fleet intelligence. We’re not just predicting failures; we’re building a future of reliable, sustainable transportation.
userContactFile.lookingFor:
I’m actively seeking strategic connections to accelerate AetherDrive’s growth. Specifically, I’m interested in:

* **Seed Investors:** Angel investors and seed funds with a focus on automotive tech, AI/ML, and sustainability. I’m looking for partners who understand the EV landscape and can provide not just capital, but also valuable industry expertise.
* **Experienced AI/ML Engineers:** Talented engineers with a strong background in time-series analysis, anomaly detection, and predictive modeling. We are building a cutting-edge platform, and I need top-tier talent to drive innovation.
* **Automotive Industry Advisors:** Seasoned professionals with deep connections within automotive OEMs and fleet management companies. I’m looking for guidance on navigating the industry, forging strategic partnerships, and scaling our business.
* **Potential Fleet Partners:** Fleet operators (logistics, delivery, rental) interested in piloting our predictive maintenance solution.  We're looking to demonstrate the ROI of AetherDrive in real-world scenarios.

I’m particularly interested in connecting with individuals who have a proven track record of success in scaling early-stage startups.  I prefer concise, direct communication and value introductions that are well-thought-out and targeted.  I'm open to virtual meetings and travel to key industry events.
userContactFile.introPreferences:
* **Hard Requirements:**
    * Individuals with direct experience in the automotive, fleet management, or AI/ML sectors.
    * Professionals at the VP level or higher, or those with demonstrable decision-making authority.
    * Contacts actively involved in investment decisions (for investor introductions).
* **Soft Preferences:**
    * Introductions should highlight the potential synergies between AetherDrive and the contact’s organization.
    * Please provide a brief context note explaining *why* you think this connection would be valuable to Theo.
    * Avoid ‘cold’ introductions; a warm connection is always preferred.  A shared connection or prior interaction is highly beneficial.
userContactFile.personalPreferences: Prefers email for initial contact. Quick, direct communication is appreciated. No LinkedIn messages, please.
userContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: Generally available for 30-60 minute meetings. Mornings (EST) are usually best. I prefer video calls to phone calls. Please send a calendar invite with a clear agenda. I am efficient with my time and value concise, focused discussions. Back-to-back meetings are difficult, so please allow buffer time between appointments.
userContactFile.background:
* **AetherDrive, Detroit, MI (2023 - Present)**
    * **Founder & CEO:** Led seed funding round ($2.5M), built core engineering team (5 FTE), and developed MVP of AI-powered predictive maintenance platform.
    * Developed and patented novel AI algorithm for predicting battery degradation with 92% accuracy.
    * Secured pilot program with two major regional logistics companies.
* **Stellantis, Auburn Hills, MI (2010 – 2023)**
    * **VP of Engineering:** Managed a team of 150+ engineers across multiple departments (Battery Technology, Thermal Management, Powertrain Control).
    * Spearheaded the development of next-generation battery thermal management systems, resulting in a 15% increase in battery lifespan and a 10% reduction in cooling energy consumption.
    * Oversaw the implementation of Agile methodologies across engineering teams, improving project delivery speed by 20%.
    * Awarded Stellantis Innovation Award for contributions to electric vehicle technology.
* **General Motors, Warren, MI (2005 – 2010)**
    * **Senior Engineer, Battery Systems:** Led the design and validation of battery packs for hybrid electric vehicles.
    * Contributed to the development of GM’s first-generation Volt battery system.
* **Education:**
    * **PhD, Electrical Engineering, Stanford University (2005)** – Dissertation: “Advanced Modeling and Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries”
    * **MS, Electrical Engineering, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (2002)**
    * **BS, Electrical Engineering, University of Michigan (2000)**
* **Skills:** AI/ML, Predictive Maintenance, Battery Technology, Thermal Management, Electric Vehicles, Software Development (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch), Agile Methodologies, Leadership, Team Management, Strategic Planning, Fundraising, Automotive Engineering, Systems Engineering, Data Analysis.
userContactFile.locationAvailability: Based in Detroit, Michigan, and willing to travel nationally for key meetings and investment opportunities. Remote meetings are also readily available.
userContactFile.notes:
* Theo is very data-driven and responds well to quantifiable results. Avoid overly hype-y pitches.
* He’s a bit reserved initially, but warms up quickly when discussing technical details.
* He's currently in a funding round and is sensitive to time constraints.
* Mentioned his patent in our last call – he's proud of it.
* Avoid introducing him to generalist investors; he wants sector specialists.

matchContactFile.positioning:
Elena Kowalski is the Founder & CEO of Synapse Insights, revolutionizing asset management in the renewable energy sector through the power of predictive maintenance. We’re building the future of sustainable energy by minimizing downtime and maximizing efficiency using cutting-edge AI and machine learning. Synapse Insights isn’t just about preventing failures; it's about proactively optimizing performance and extending asset lifecycles. Our core technology leverages a proprietary blend of physics-informed machine learning models and real-time sensor data analysis to accurately predict component failures in wind and solar farms—before they happen. 

Initially, Synapse Insights focused solely on wind turbine gearbox failure prediction, a historically costly and complex challenge. We've successfully completed a year-long pilot program with 'Northern Power Systems,' demonstrating a 30% reduction in unscheduled maintenance and a 15% increase in energy production. We are now pivoting to a platform approach – expanding our capabilities to cover broader turbine components and integrating solar farm monitoring. This expansion is driven by strong customer demand and represents a significant market opportunity. 

My expertise lies at the intersection of data science, mechanical engineering, and renewable energy. I’m passionate about leveraging AI to create a more sustainable future and building a world-class team to deliver on that vision.  *One-liner:*  Synapse Insights empowers renewable energy companies to unlock the full potential of their assets through intelligent, predictive maintenance.
matchContactFile.lookingFor:
Currently focused on closing our Series A round ($5-7M) to scale Synapse Insights and expand our platform.  Specifically seeking:

* **Investors:**  VC firms specializing in industrial AI, climate tech, or energy tech.  Looking for partners who can provide not only capital but also strategic guidance and access to industry networks.
* **Strategic Partnerships:**  Renewable energy companies (wind and solar farm operators, manufacturers) interested in piloting or integrating our predictive maintenance solutions.  Open to joint development projects and data sharing agreements.
* **Advisor/Board Member:** Experienced executive with a strong track record in scaling SaaS businesses in the industrial sector.
* **Chief Revenue Officer (CRO):**  A proven sales leader with experience selling AI-powered solutions to enterprise customers.  Must have a strong understanding of the renewable energy market.

Geographic focus: North America and Europe.  Open to remote collaboration, but prefer partners with a presence in key energy markets.  Ideally, we are looking for partners who understand the complexities of the energy sector and the importance of reliability and efficiency.  I'm available for introductory calls to discuss potential collaborations.
matchContactFile.introPreferences:
When making introductions, please:

* Briefly highlight Synapse Insights' focus on predictive maintenance for renewable energy.
* Emphasize the successful pilot program with Northern Power Systems and the 30% reduction in unscheduled maintenance.
* Frame the introduction as an opportunity to explore potential investment, partnership, or advisory roles.
* Avoid introducing me to individuals solely focused on consumer AI or unrelated industries.
* Include a brief bio of the person you're introducing me to, highlighting their relevant experience and interests.
* Keep the intro email concise and focused on the value proposition for both parties.
matchContactFile.personalPreferences: I prefer initial communication via email.  Happy to jump on a call after a brief exchange.  I check Slack occasionally but prefer not to use it for first contact.
matchContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: I’m in the Eastern Time Zone (EST).  Generally available for meetings during business hours, but flexible for early morning or late afternoon calls.  Please send a calendar invite with a clear agenda.  I prefer meetings to be no longer than 30 minutes initially.
matchContactFile.background:
- **Synapse Insights, Founder & CEO** (2022 – Present)
  - Led all aspects of the company, from initial concept and technology development to fundraising, pilot program execution, and team building.
  - Secured seed funding of $1.2M from angel investors and early-stage venture capital firms.
  - Oversaw the development and deployment of our core predictive maintenance platform, achieving a 30% reduction in unscheduled maintenance during the Northern Power Systems pilot.
  - Developed and implemented the company's go-to-market strategy.

- **Vestas, Senior Data Scientist** (2014 – 2022)
  - Led the development of machine learning models for predicting component failures in wind turbines, focusing on gearbox, blade, and generator health.
  - Collaborated with engineering teams to integrate predictive maintenance insights into operational workflows.
  - Managed large-scale datasets from wind farms across North America, utilizing cloud-based data processing and storage solutions (AWS, Azure).
  -  Mentored junior data scientists and engineers.
  - Published research papers on predictive maintenance in renewable energy at industry conferences.

- **University of California, Berkeley, Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering** (2010 – 2014)
  - Dissertation: 'Data-Driven Modeling of Fatigue Crack Propagation in Wind Turbine Blades.'
  -  Specialization:  Computational Mechanics, Machine Learning, and Renewable Energy.

- **Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), B.S. in Mechanical Engineering** (2006 – 2010)

**Skills:** Machine Learning (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn), Data Science (Data Mining, Statistical Modeling, Data Visualization), Predictive Maintenance, Renewable Energy (Wind/Solar), Time Series Analysis, Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure), SQL, Signal Processing, Physics-Informed Machine Learning, Team Leadership, Fundraising, Strategic Planning.

**Certifications:** AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, Certified Data Science Professional (CDSP)
matchContactFile.locationAvailability: Based in Boston, MA.  Willing to travel for key meetings and investor pitches.  Also comfortable with remote meetings and collaboration.  Prefer partners located in North America or Europe.
matchContactFile.notes:
• Spoke with David Chen (Lightspeed Venture Partners) last week – positive initial conversation, sending follow-up deck. He's interested in our pilot results. 
•  Northern Power Systems very happy with pilot – potential for a larger, multi-year contract.  Follow up with Sarah Miller (NPS Head of Operations) next week. 
•  Need to refine pitch deck to emphasize the scalability of our platform and the total addressable market. 
•  Elena is very comfortable discussing the technical details of the platform but can also articulate the business value. 
•  Avoid pitching her on purely 'general purpose' AI solutions – she’s focused on domain expertise. 
•  She's *very* busy – keep introductions concise & focused.

qc.judge_reasoning: Both individuals are founders of early-stage companies focused on predictive maintenance using AI/ML, making them excellent peers for knowledge sharing regarding technical challenges, fundraising, and scaling operations. While they operate in different sectors (EV fleet management vs. renewable energy), the underlying technical and business hurdles—such as proving ROI to industrial clients and scaling physics-informed ML models—are highly analogous. This peer-to-peer connection offers significant value for both founders to exchange best practices and potentially share investor networks.
